paragraphs.text: Cockatrice is a creature type for a species flying creatures that can turn their enemies to stone , much like Basilisks . They have lithe, feathery, serpentine bodies with the head of a bird, two legs, and two wings. They are the size of a large horse.

Only 3 cockatrices have been printed so far in mono- green , mono- black , and green-blue , respectively. Consequently, they don't have a standard color in which they appear, though this may change in the future.

The type was for a long time only used once, for the card Cockatrice in Alpha . In Magic 2014 it finally returned as a black -aligned creature ( Deathgaze Cockatrice ). It was argued that though deathtouch suited both colors, green didn't get flying creatures anymore, making black the easiest fit with both deathtouch and flying. Journey into Nyx added the green/ blue Fleetfeather Cockatrice , using blue to justify the flying.
In 35 AR , a red-and-green-scaled cockatrice called the " Beast of the Hours " threatened Sumifa . It was contained inside an Armageddon Clock , and powerful enough to cause Armageddon .
A cockatrice was once summoned by Jared Carthalion when he was inside Castle Melmereth . It was killed and destroyed by a Clockwork Avian .
